message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && grep -RIn "gf_isom_open_file(.*READ_DUMP\|READ_DUMP" src/isomedia src/filters include | head -50 && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
p='/workspace/candidate_trace.json'
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_parse.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":12,"var":"data/size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written unchanged to a temporary file that becomes the parser input."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_parse.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"filename","code":"movie = gf_isom_open_file(filename, GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ_DUMP, NULL);","note":"The fuzz target opens that file in ISO read/dump mode, handing the crafted bytes to GPAC's ISO parser."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_intern.c","function":"gf_isom_open_file","line":794,"var":"mov->movieFileMap","code":"e = gf_isom_datamap_new(fileName, NULL, GF_ISOM_DATA_MAP_READ_ONLY, &mov->movieFileMap);","note":"The parser maps the attacker-controlled file for read-only parsing, so subsequent box readers consume the crafted contents."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_open_file","line":1032,"var":"movie->openMode","code":"if (movie->openMode != GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ_DUMP) {","note":"Read/dump mode enables the code path that parses and dumps box structures while retaining references into parser-owned storage."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/isomedia/box_dump.c","function":"gf_isom_box_dump","line":3434,"var":"utf16Line","code":"((char *)utf16Line)[txt->len] = 0;","note":"A box-dump helper writes a terminator into a buffer derived from parsed state; the reported bug is a stack-use-after-return write triggered during this parsing/dumping flow."}
]
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
print(open(p).read())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz_parse.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 127.
